Definition: Chushim, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hushim is the name of three Israelites: a son of Dan who goes down into Egypt, a son of Aher in Benjamin's line, and a son of Shaharaim by his wife Hushim. The name appears in lists only, with no story for any of the three. Each one is counted in his father's household.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hushim matters because three men share one name and God counts all three, and no one is lost in a crowd.
